{{Quote|Glad to share my skills with someone talented.|Briqui|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Briqui''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Trained as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]], the [[Color/Legends|blue]]-skinned and blue-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] over his white and gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and wielded a single [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Near the end of the Cold War, he was stationed as an [[Jedi instructor|instructor]] of other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Sarala]] and [[Cassa Hun]] on [[Carrick Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] on the edge of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] that served as the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] staging area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Briqui first appeared in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released in [[2011]], where he is the Jedi Knight trainer aboard Carrick Station.<ref name="TOR" />
